reviewed_by: Delegated Task B coding agent: source-semantic review against the live Binary Ninja 6.0.10601 MCP view of retail igi.exe (entry 0x004A50F5) and the bound Radare2 artifacts; candidate translation unit recompiled with the repository -O3 flags.
review_basis: The current engine/src/retail/model/iff_chunk_tree.cpp hashes to 69b2e71f88a595c3cfcccf5b40df8c3ca54412b41ff46f09a0585175dc050ace. The retail entry was re-read through the live Binary Ninja view (decompile and block/edge sets) for this review, and the bound Radare2 artifact is unchanged. The candidate object and its linked-image symbol were then compared to that reconstruction. This review supersedes the earlier report that did not use the seven required semantic check names or that described the retail child link offset incorrectly.

candidate_function.summary: IffChunk_FindChildByTag: walks a form's children from first_child, recurses into nested forms, matches a plain chunk on its tag.

checks.name: function_identity
checks.detail: Retail 0x00517940 (Binary Ninja Terrain_SelectTerrainLOD_6) is the find-child-by-tag walk: it starts at the form's first child at +0x08, descends into nested forms, and matches the tag at +0x10. The candidate IffChunk_FindChildByTag is the same routine.

checks.name: argument_mapping
checks.detail: Retail signature void**(void* arg1, int32_t arg2): arg1 is a form whose first child is read at +0x08, arg2 the 32-bit tag. Candidate IffChunk_FindChildByTag(IffChunkNode*, std::uint32_t) keeps the same layout.

checks.name: constants_and_scaling
checks.detail: Same FORM marker 0x464F524D and offsets +0x08 (first child), +0x00 (next), +0x10 (tag); no scaling.

checks.name: memory_layout_and_access
checks.detail: Same representation difference: the form's first child is read through the typed field that the port parser fills in the retail position.

checks.name: calls_and_side_effects
checks.detail: Retail makes one self-recursive call for a nested form and no other calls. Candidate IffChunk_FindChildByTag is likewise self-recursive and has no side effects.

checks.name: return_and_error_paths
checks.detail: Retail returns the selected child pointer or null. The candidate returns the same selected child or nullptr.

checks.name: floating_point_semantics
checks.rationale: No floating-point value, constant or comparison appears in the retail function or the candidate.

checks.name: addressability
checks.detail: Present with external linkage (nm type T) at 0x004235B0 in build-clean-win32/igi1.exe under the retail catalog name Iff_FindChunk, pinned by the asm-label on the declaration in engine/include/igi/retail/model/iff_chunk_tree.hpp and inherited by the out-of-line definition; 4 direct call site(s) (per caller: AnimIff_LoadAnimationFile x3, Iff_FindChunk x1). The C++ source identifier remains IffChunk_FindChildByTag.

checks.name: port_only_divergence
checks.detail: Port-only divergence: C++ source identifier IffChunk_FindChildByTag and typed pointers instead of the retail ABI; the emitted assembler name now matches the retail catalog name, and the compiled body is byte-identical to the pre-change object.

signature_comparison.rationale: Retail is void**(void*, int32_t); the candidate is IffChunkNode*(IffChunkNode*, std::uint32_t). The layout is preserved; the retail's void* versus void** distinction is a decompiler artifact of the same 32-bit pointer.

limitations: The port holds the tree by value/unique_ptr; raw retail link addresses are not reproduced.
No live paired retail/candidate game-process capture exists; STRUCTURALLY_VERIFIED is the maximum supported status.
The CFG agreement cited is Binary Ninja vs Radare2 on the retail image, not a candidate-vs-retail isomorphism score.

port_only_divergences.detail: retail symbol name Iff_FindChunk equals the candidate emitted symbol Iff_FindChunk; the C++ source identifier IffChunk_FindChildByTag is pinned with a declaration-level asm-label. Instruction bytes and relocations are unchanged by the label.

addressability_rebind.change: declaration-level GCC asm-label added to the owning header; no definition, computation, argument, return value or side effect changed
addressability_rebind.note: This rebind re-established the symbol and linked-image address after the assembler-name change. The semantic findings above were not re-derived; they remain bound to implementation SHA-256 69b2e71f88a595c3cfcccf5b40df8c3ca54412b41ff46f09a0585175dc050ace. Addressability is not behavioural evidence.
